subject: SLA impact: proposal for reparative credits and contractual carve-out
messages:
From: Aarti Shah <aarti@bluestar.ai>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: BlueStar Support <support@bluestar.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production impact this week — request for remediation and credit

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

We saw sustained latency spikes and an availability dip across our production routing between Oct 26–30 (~3% availability shortfall and p95 latency regressions of ~400ms). Our customers reported degraded search relevance and an outage window for one of our high-volume endpoints on Oct 29.

We’ve attached a short incident summary and a sample of the request latency timeseries that our ops team captured. This impacted three paying customers at the premium tier and resulted in SLA breach notifications.

Immediate asks:
- A concise remediation deliverable (what went wrong and what’s fixed) and ETA for full stabilization
- A remediation credit/compensation structure (credit to invoice or free month, your preference)
- A short-term mitigation we can rely on while you finish the root-cause fixes (fallback routing / pinning suggestion)

We need to present this to our execs tomorrow morning. Please treat this as high priority — we appreciate a clear offer we can sign off on.

Thanks,
Aarti
Aarti Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, BlueStar AI

Attachments: bluestar-incident-summary-20261101.pdf, latency-timeseries.csv
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Production impact this week — request for remediation and credit

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding BlueStar’s incident note. Key points: availability shortfall ~3% over 5 days, p95 latency up ~400ms, impacted premium customers and triggered breach notices. BlueStar has asked for (1) remediation summary + ETA, (2) credit/compensation, (3) short-term mitigation.

My read: this looks like a cross-region routing regression combined with a transient kernel path that hurt small-batch latency on our older quantized stacks. We can offer a structured remediation package:
- Technical: emergency hotfix (already in progress with infra) + 48–72h stability window and a postmortem within 5 business days
- Commercial options (pick one):
  A) 10% invoice credit for Nov + one-time $5k goodwill credit toward professional services
  B) 30% invoice credit for Nov (escalated concession)
  C) One complimentary month of Dedicated (trial-style) + 5% invoice credit for Nov, with a 6-month usage cap clause

I think option A+PS credit is defensible for mid-sized customers to close quickly; B is heavier and should come with Exec approval; C is a product gesture (higher operational cost). Need your go/no-go on scope and signoff for anything >20% or a free month. Also confirm whether legal needs to approve a temporary carve-out or contract amendment (we may need DocuSign).

I’m copying BlueStar next once we have a decision.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact this week — request for remediation and credit

Chloe — agree with your assessment. A few points:
- We should prioritize a quick, simple offer to resolve today’s exec ask. Option A + $5k PS credit gets us a clean close and shows goodwill.
- If BlueStar pushes for a deeper concession, we can escalate to Option B but require a revenue protection clause (6-month minimum commit) and exec approval.
- For the short-term mitigation, propose we enable prefix-caching and route their traffic to the newer kernel pool for critical endpoints; ops can enact that as a hot patch today.

If Karthik signs off on A (+PS credit) I’ll prep the note and the DocuSign amendment template. 

Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact this week — request for remediation and credit

Approved.

Sign off on Option A: 10% invoice credit for November + one-time $5k PS credit. No long-term contract changes required for this concession. Ops to enable routing mitigation and deliver the 48–72h stabilization update.

Marissa, proceed with DocuSign using the standard credit amendment. Chloe, share a clear timeline with BlueStar and include the incident summary and the mitigation steps.

—Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti@bluestar.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, BlueStar Support <support@bluestar.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Production impact this week — request for remediation and credit

Hi Aarti,

Thanks again for the clear incident packet — very helpful. We’ve validated the root causes and are deploying the mitigation this afternoon (routing their critical endpoints to the newer kernel pool + enabling prefix caching). Ops expects a 48–72 hour stabilization window and will provide an interim status update by EOD tomorrow. A full postmortem will follow within five business days.

Commercial resolution (executive-approved):
- 10% credit applied to November’s invoice (will appear as a line-item credit)
- One-time $5,000 professional services credit you can apply toward tuning or a short-term migration engagement

We will not require a contract amendment for this credit; however, I will send a short DocuSign acknowledgment to confirm the credit line for bookkeeping. Marissa is preparing that now and will include the credit breakdown.

As a short-term mitigation, our ops runbook will pin the critical endpoints to a lower-latency kernel for 7 days while we monitor. If you’d like the Dedicated trial instead of the PS credit, let me know and we can switch to that option (requires a quick technical coordinate).

I’ve attached the incident summary we received and the latency sample you sent for reference. Next steps:
- Marissa will send the DocuSign acknowledgment today
- Ops: interim update by EOD tomorrow, full postmortem in 5 business days
- Chloe: follow-up in 3 days to confirm stabilization and any further credit needs

Appreciate the patience and we’ll keep this moving.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: bluestar-incident-summary-20261101.pdf, latency-timeseries.csv
